title: TesseraFlow: Scalable Video Diffusion for Dynamic Medical Imaging Inverse Problems
abstract: arXiv:2611.29099v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative priors are state-of-the-art for modeling medical images in image reconstruction tasks, but reconstruction with video priors takes tens of seconds to minutes per frame. Latent priors inherit the errors of their autoencoder, the memory of pixel-space whole-frame priors grows with the frame size, and pixel-space patch priors are slow for two reasons. First, their deep networks process every frame at full resolution at every sampling step, even though early steps resolve only low frequencies. Second, their samplers spend many network evaluations per sampling step on overlapping windows, multiple re-noising rounds, or backpropagation through the prior. We introduce TesseraFlow, a complex-valued pixel-space flow prior that reduces the first cost. A global encoder reads a low-resolution view of every frame once per sampling step. translated_title: TesseraFlow：面向动态医学成像逆问题的可扩展视频扩散模型
translated_abstract: 生成式先验是图像重建任务中建模医学图像的最先进方法，但使用视频先验进行重建时，每帧需要数十秒到数分钟的时间。隐空间先验会继承其自编码器的误差，像素空间整帧先验的内存占用随帧尺寸增长，而像素空间分块先验速度慢的原因有两个。第一，其深度网络在每次采样步骤都以全分辨率处理每一帧，即使早期步骤仅解析低频信息。第二，其采样器在每个采样步骤上花费大量网络评估用于重叠窗口、多次重加噪轮次或经过先验的反向传播。我们提出了TesseraFlow，一种复数值像素空间流先验，可降低第一种成本。一个全局编码器在每个采样步骤读取每帧一次低分辨率视图。单个浅层解码器在早期步骤中对该视图进行操作，随后在全分辨率时空平铺上运行……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: TesseraFlow提出了一种复数值像素空间视频流先验，通过全局低分辨率编码与浅层解码器的分级处理策略，显著加速动态医学影像逆问题的重建，同时规避了隐空间先验的误差传递以及像素空间方法的内存和计算瓶颈。
en_tdlr: TesseraFlow introduces a complex-valued pixel-space video flow prior that dramatically accelerates reconstruction of dynamic medical imaging inverse problems through a global low-resolution encoder and shallow decoder design, avoiding both the error inheritance of latent priors and the memory and computation bottlenecks of pixel-space approaches.
